policy.runtime: All audio is bundled locally. No CDN, streaming, microphone, speech synthesis, or runtime generation is used.
policy.music: The release ambience is deterministic, sample-free project audio generated by scripts/generate-audio-music.py. The user-provided 妙响 candidate tracks were used to establish the intended day/night/horde/dawn roles, but are not embedded in this reproducible fallback build because uploaded chat binaries are not directly mounted into the local DevSpace workspace.
policy.sfx: All short event and UI sounds are deterministic, sample-free project audio generated by scripts/generate-audio-sfx.py.
policy.replacement: Approved mastered tracks can later replace the five bgm_*.mp3 files without changing gameplay, save data, or AudioDirector mappings.
